test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'DEAL' is coded as '22', 'EACH' is coded as '17'. What is the code for 'HALF' in that code language?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d302beb360dd4d3096b436cf559523cc8a64bf28a37b43c146e6773b3626f00.png] 

**Logic:** 'Sum of the positional values of the alphabet'.

'DEAL' is coded as '22'→

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/627da47fed6a82c33c020b2289bf6d5ef117de80b0eeba11772bbf8207c0dfe4.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e13c044cb0e482329c4504c9063e08c92df5f29bae004b8e275fbca783e98ee8.png] 

'EACH' is coded as '17'→

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56efd39e0681f35d45b69870d77ca05cbe52780ea17d956754e944a15cccb224.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83d3c7c3366d023eb27f1808115e47a6df9e3e825959b0bcb7ed794b664fa2bc.png] 

Similarly, 'HALF' will be coded as→

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/677eb89facac7cdd7283278ef44b90a554de24416900df105fd25f2d75bf2451.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fadafdfc5279ebe5001f457a5552d06e297e4c398a837d2c4c3dad1de86ec16e.png] 

Here, 'HALF' is coded as **'27'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".
